body:
I had wanted to try salvia for some time know, and me and two other friends wanted to try it also, so I ordered one gram of 5x salvia. Me and one other friend decided to try it we went to his house and packed a bong, I had was having a rather good day, and was excited to try this amazing plant I have read many reports mostly good and some bad, to there was always this thought in the back of my mind that it could go bad, I had never trip on anything before I smoke marijuana a couple of times a week.
I hit the bong and pasted it then hit it again, I felt my body moving backward, and quickly hit it 2 more times. The next thing I remebered was a vast ocean I was standing in the water I felt wet, soaked, the water was heavy. I didnt know I was tripping all I new was I was in water an ocean surrounded me, and slowly I could see the room I was still tripping hard, at first I could not believe what happened, I didnt like it it was too intense I could not believe that I tripped that hard.
I sat down and asked my freind what happened it felt like I was in the ocean for 2 hours, but he said I got up and walked to the window and then sat down and that was it. I dont remeber walking around I had a hard time looking at him he didnt look the same, this was only 7 minutes in to the trip I leaned back and I felt the wall and all of a sudden I feel back, I closed my I and watch a red curtain flowing this for 2 mins. At this point I hear the music it was phish, one of my favorite bands. I thought about the trip and I loved it, it was intense but a blast. Nothing spiritual but I hope in future trips I be able to use salvia as a tool to discover my self better.
